Core Hardware: Apple Watch Ultra shown in titanium with low-profile design; powered by the S11 chip.

Battery & Power: 50-hour battery life; Faster charging.

Sensors & Vitals: Most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable; Live heart rate (62 BPM); Heart Rate Variability (HRV) tracking; Health Sensing System with optical sensor rings.

An Apple summary slide on a light background focusing on software analytics and wellness metrics.

Audio Technologies: Best-in-class Active Noise Cancellation; Personalized Spatial Audio; Adaptive Audio; Transparency mode; Conversation Awareness; Next-generation Adaptive EQ; Custom EQ.

Smart Features & Communication: Live Translation (showing "你好 / Hello"); Hands-free Siri AI; Voice Isolation; Camera remote shutter control.

Battery Life: Up to 5 hours with Active Noise Cancellation.

An Apple bento box summary slide highlighting next-generation iPhone Pro specifications.

Performance & Hardware: A20 Pro chip driving massive performance gains; Next-generation Vapor chamber cooling; Faster wired charging.

Display & Design: Available in 6.3" and 6.9" display sizes; Redesigned Dynamic Island UI; Available in Dark Grey, Natural Titanium, Blue Titanium, and Dark Bronze-Red.

Camera System: 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture; 4x/8x Fusion Telephoto lens; Pro manual controls; Photographic Styles with texture control; Cinematic video mode; Apple Reference Image support.

Software & AI: Apple Intelligence; Siri AI integration; Best battery life ever in an iPhone.
